latHint: Think emptying water from a boat - not a cricket bit.
pivHint: A BAIL sits atop cricket stumps - but to BAIL a leaky boat means to do what to the water?
winText: Dry decks. BAIL was the pivot - a cricket crosspiece to SCOOPing water.
lossText: SCOOP - to lift out with a dipper. BAIL was the pivot: cricket BAIL to BAILing a boat.
